row.notes: In Game_PitStopActionObserver_SetTransitionSequence's prefixed name builder: the instruction after the call to Sess_Penalty_IsServedAtNextStop (0x1403bd99d, car = [inst+0x358] ? byte [inst+0x350] : 0xff, inst = [r13+8]); al = the answer, r13 = the observer. al true and g_stopGoDuration exactly 10 or 5 add the 10SP or 5SP suffix to the crew sequence name (0x1403bd9aa..0x1403bd9bc). Setting al here picks the stop-go crew clip for that car only. The instruction at the site is RIP-relative (vmovss xmm0,[rip+disp] to 0x145f9677c, 8 bytes); the hook relocates it.

verify.notes: gh:serve-verify Confirmed: call 0x142f29600 at 0x1403bd99d with rcx = r14 = [rsp+0x148] = [[inst+0x3c0]+0x80] (reloaded on every path in: 0x1403bd6e4, 0x1403bd7e9, 0x1403bd7f6), edx = [inst+0x358] ? byte [inst+0x350] : 0xff, inst = [r13+8]; r13 = rcx from 0x1403bc327 and never rewritten. al is read at 0x1403bd9ba and 0x1403bd9d5 with no write between; dl = al and duration == 10.0 picks 10SP, cl = al and duration == 5.0 picks 5SP. The site instruction is RIP-relative (vmovss xmm0,[rip+disp] to 0x145f9677c, 8 bytes), so the mid hook must relocate it; no branch lands inside it. Same on 1.0.145 at 0x1403bd9e2.
